Meanwhile, solar energy is anticipated to maintain its leadership position with a forecasted share of 50% in 2025, despite a slight decline in the 2024 actuals, which stood at 60%. Other renewable sources, such as hydroelectric power, will also play an integral role, with the 2024 actual generation amounting to 10 AUD million.

p10_b4.ocr: Geothermal energy, although currently contributing a modest 3% to the market share, offers potential for growth as technological advancements reduce costs and enhance efficiency.
